title: Clinical Study to Evaluate the Performance of Magna Ease Heart Valve in Chinese Patients
brief_summary: Clinical Study to Evaluate the Performance of Magna Ease Heart Valve in Chinese patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The patients who implanted with Magna Ease Heart Valve (Type:7300TFX and 3300TFX) in Fuwai Hospital in China.
* The patients agree to sign the inform consent form (ICF).

Exclusion Criteria:

* No specific exclusion criteria.
study_population: The patients who had the heart valves (Type: 7300TFX and 3300TFX), and are willing to participate in the study.
condition: Mitral Valve or Aortic Valve Replacement
